title: Rewinding the work-tape head
statement: Let $x$ and $b$ be finite binary words, let $p$ be any input-head position among the $|x|+2$ positions, and let $j$ be a natural number with $j\le |b|$. Starting in the rewind state with input head at $p$, work head at $j-1$, tape contents given by $b$, and empty output, after $j+1$ steps the machine is in the count state with input head still at $p$, work head at $0$, tape contents still given by $b$, and empty output.
replaced:
Suppose the four-state binary-counter machine is in its rewind state with a
binary word $b$ on the nonnegative work-tape cells, empty output, and work head
at cell $j - 1$ for some natural number $j \le |b|$ (so possibly at the blank
cell $-1$). Then after exactly $j + 1$ steps the machine is in the count state
with the work head at cell $0$, and the stored word, input-head position, and
output all unchanged.
